concepts.meta_headline: Watch the fireworks, not your screen
concepts.meta_primary_text: At Magic Kingdom, the fireworks show begins and suddenly hundreds of glowing phones block the view of Cinderella Castle. Instead of watching the spectacle through six inches of glass, Retra sits on your wrist to capture candid memories in a single click. Up to 500 photos per charge, rechargeable, and zero screens to pull you away from your kids. Transfer via USB-C. Now $99 for Black Friday.

concepts.angle: Disney park day unposed photo diary
concepts.meta_primary_text: A full day at Disney moves fast: from rope drop on Main Street to night fireworks over Cinderella Castle. You do not want to spend the entire trip checking screen angles or deleting bad takes. Retra gives you candid, textured memories in four built-in film-look filters. No screen, no apps, and no Wi-Fi. Up to 500 photos per charge on the included card. Plug in via USB-C when you get home. Now $99.

concepts.meta_headline: Memories your future family will cherish
concepts.meta_primary_text: Years from now, nobody remembers the emails you checked in line at Magic Kingdom. They remember walking past Cinderella Castle holding hands and looking up together. Retra is a screen-free camera built for pure presence. It holds up to 500 photos per charge on the included memory card, with four built-in film filters. Connect via USB-C when you get home. Now $99 during our Black Friday sale.

slots.text: We stood in front of Cinderella Castle and promised not to look at our phones all day. We laughed, we got sticky churro fingers, and we actually looked each other in the eyes. Best trip ever.

concepts.meta_headline: The camera built for Disney trips
concepts.meta_primary_text: Planning your Disney trip? Retra is the screen-free digital camera designed for family presence on Main Street. Point, click, and drop it back into your bag. Up to 500 photos on a charge, four built-in film filters, and direct USB-C export to your computer. Available in six colours: Chalk, Obsidian, Sol, Dune, Pine, and Blossom. On sale for $99 (compare at $165). Buy 2, Get 1 Free.
